clips.title: The story
paras: At Stonetalon Peak, Keeper Albagorm sends Alliance fighters to clear the Bloodfury harpies from the ruined Charred Vale. Their removal will open a path for druids and caretakers to begin healing the scorched land.

South of Stonetalon Peak, the Charred Vale lies in ash and smoldering ruins where a lush alpine haven once stood. A mechanized logging and mining army swept through the sacred crags, stripping trees and setting uncontrolled fires. For the guardians around Stonetalon, ancient woodland lost to industrial greed is a wound they cannot ignore.

Bloodfury harpies took hold in the ashes left by the mechanical fires. Opportunistic and vicious, they swarm the smoking lowlands, nest there, and aggressively ambush anyone who approaches the valley. Keeper Albagorm and his allies cannot walk the soil to sow seeds of renewal; the harpies violently bar passage to every outsider.

Restoration cannot begin until the Bloodfury roosts are broken. Albagorm sends seasoned Alliance fighters deep among the tribe to slay its hunters, ambushers, and roguefeathers. Thinning their predatory flock is the first step toward reclaiming the land for nature and giving the forest spirits room to breathe once more.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As a protector of the forest spirits you can undoubtedly guess why I am alarmed.
You have traveled through these mountains to reach this peak. Surely you have seen the travesty which has befallen the land. Greed has led to the destruction of these sacred hills.
The Charred Vale to the south was set afire by the greedy mechanized army of industrialists. Worse yet, the Bloodfuries that have encroached on the land refuse us passage in to begin regrowth.
Drive the wretched harpies out, friend!

clips.title: Progress
paras: There is much work to be done before the Charred Vale can be restored to the lush forest it once was.
Clear the area of those foul menaces, Friend! Only then can we begin to reclaim what belongs to nature.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Now that the Bloodfuries have suffered such a great loss, perhaps the true work of restoring the land can begin....
